notes: Cats Alive (Fren Pet), Base application: deploy only src/CatsAlive.sol:CatsAlive. CatRenderer and ViewerScript are internal libraries embedded in its bytecode. Constructor order is initialOwner (address), initialReporter (address), originalCats_ (uint32), originalMintTimestamp_ (uint64 Unix seconds), maxReportAge_ (uint32 seconds). The original cat count, original mint timestamp and freshness threshold are immutable. The launch owner controls administration and initially publishes reports; the owner can replace the reporter. Reports become stale when block.timestamp exceeds their observation time by more than 3600 seconds, not 3600 seconds after publication. Historical inputs are provisional, derived from https://api.pet.game/ on 2026-10-03 at indexed Base block 52113074: pets(where:{dna_starts_with:"6-"},limit:1000) returned 37 records including three dead cats, with no next page. The earliest indexed createdAt is 1708988049 (2024-02-26 22:54:09 UTC); another cat record is dated 2024-03-01. These observations establish the indexed cohort, not verified original issuance. The immutable original count/date and the contract's unconditional one-time-mint/no-future-cats statement therefore remain unresolved review findings; this manifest does not establish their historical accuracy. The value 37 is the maximum accepted alive-cat report; it does not cap FPCA supply. FPCA name and symbol are fixed in the accepted source; initial NFT supply is zero and mint() is unlimited, free, nonpayable and directly callable from a block explorer. The non-upgradeable owner can pause minting; ordinary transfers remain available without fees or limits. Metadata, sprite, SVG and interactive HTML are embedded onchain and link to https://pet.game. SVG uses the latest authorized report and changes layout between blocks; interactive HTML randomizes on opening and attempts the API, falling back to reported data. Fresh data and a new layout on every marketplace view depend on reporting, API access, viewer support and caching. Deployment starts unreported (alive_cats null, artwork --), with no invented live count. publishCount is ongoing reporter operation, not an initialization call. No separate fungible token, pool, reward distributor, funding or initialization transaction is included.
